content.text: A feature to allow users to permanently delete their mobile banking account and associated data.
The system shall require a multi-step confirmation (e.g., password re-entry or security code) before initiating account deletion.
The system shall send a confirmation email to the user once the deletion process has been successfully initiated.
The system shall block account deletion if any of the following conditions are met:

- The account has an active balance greater than $0.
    - There are pending transactions.
    - There are active loans or credit products.
    - There are unresolved support tickets.
What is the data retention period after an account is marked for deletion?
Is a multi-step confirmation process required?
Should the user receive a confirmation email upon deletion?
Are there any conditions that prevent deletion (e.g., active loans, pending transactions)?
